_comment: Focus pages for cold outreach (docs/cold-outreach.md). David owns this file: agents may not add, remove, or reorder pages, only read it. Every email pitches exactly one page from this list. 'proof' entries are facts the agent must re-confirm on the live page each run before quoting them; 'anchors' are deep-link ids that exist in catalog.json. 'kill_after' = sends with zero substantive replies before the page is paused (scripts/cold_outreach.py enforces it).

pages.prospects: AI newsletter editors; university library AI guides (libguides); bootcamp and course 'tools' pages; blog posts comparing models that link a stale pricing or model list
pages.angle: One decision hub for choosing a model by task, cost and openness, with the deep dives (picker, API pricing, coding agents, open weights) one click away.

pages.prospects: AI safety reading lists and course syllabi (university, AISF-style cohorts); EA/rationalist group resource pages; newsletter editors covering AI policy
pages.angle: A field guide that puts the core case, a p(doom) estimate, key thinkers, governance and a concept glossary on one page, routing to deep dives.

pages.prospects: energy and grid newsletter editors; local reporters and planning-commission explainers on data center projects; engineering course pages on power and cooling
pages.angle: The AI data center stack layer by layer (chips, grid-to-GPU power chain, cooling limits, community impact), sourced and in one place.

pages.prospects: space newsletter editors; planetarium, science-center and astronomy-club resource pages; STEM teacher resource lists
pages.angle: Launch vehicles compared by payload, thrust and reuse, then the whole spaceflight stack from launch to habitats, as one hub.

pages.prospects: articles and forum wikis comparing Starship, New Glenn and Falcon that cite outdated specs; STEM classroom resource pages
pages.angle: Starship, New Glenn, Falcon Heavy, Falcon 9, Ariane 6, Vulcan and Long March 5 side by side with dated specs.

pages.prospects: bootcamp and CS-course resource pages; awesome-list style curated pages maintained by a named person; developer newsletter editors
pages.angle: A role-and-task router into dense guides on architecture, .NET, APIs, databases, SQL tuning, DevOps, observability, Git, cloud, JavaScript and Python.

pages.prospects: sysadmin and homelab blogs with a hardening post that links a dead or pre-2022 checklist; university IT security guides; VPS provider community tutorials maintained by a named author
pages.angle: An interactive, phase-by-phase hardening checklist with copy-paste commands (SSH, ufw, fail2ban, systemd sandboxing, sysctl) and a verification pass.

pages.prospects: compliance and fintech newsletter editors; digital-asset law firm resource pages; university fintech course reading lists. Never custody vendors pitching their own product.
pages.angle: A vendor-neutral map of digital-asset custody: 34 operating decisions against five custody models, with an incident router.

pages.prospects: ham radio club and ARES/CERT resource pages; emergency-preparedness group link lists; license-class instructors
pages.angle: A visual, keep-open programming reference for the UV-5R with key guides and screen-icon definitions.
